identity.title: The M<SUB>BH</SUB>─M<SUB>∗</SUB> Relation of the Hyperluminous Dust-obscured Quasars up to z ∼ 4

paper_type_evidence.quote: Three sources (J1126, J0220, and J0116) have ALMA data collected from ALMA Science Archive

targets.name: 11 hyperluminous Hot DOGs at z=1.5-3.7 (e.g. J0220, J0116, J1126)

question.value: Do hyperluminous Hot DOGs at z=1.5-3.7 follow the local M_BH-M_star relation, and what are their Eddington ratios?

evidence.quote: We investigate the $M_{\rm BH}-M_\star$ relation in these sources using Bayesian spectral energy distribution (SED) fitting or with extra constraints from *Hubble Space Telescope* (HST) image decomposition.
We first select sources from ALLWISE Data Release (cite: Cutri2014) using the following selection criteria
All 14 sources have SDSS DR18 $ugriz$ bands photometry (cite: Almeida2023).

provided.value: Imaging for 4 sources used in image decomposition

evidence.quote: Four sources (J0851, J0220, J0116, and J0834) have HST imaging from MAST

provided.value: FIR photometry for J0851, J0220, J0116

evidence.quote: three sources (J0851, J0220, and J0116) have *Herschel* data

what.value: HAWC+/SOFIA, SCUBA-2, SMA far-IR to mm photometry for J1013

evidence.quote: J1013 has HAWC+/SOFIA 89 $\mu$m and 154 $\mu$m, SCUBA-2/JCMT 450 $\mu$m and 850 $\mu$m, SMA 870 $\mu$m and 1.3mm data from (cite: Toba2020).

what.value: Broad-line FWHM and BH mass recipes from SDSS DR16 quasar catalog

evidence.quote: Then we substitute the FWHM of the broad emission line from the (cite: Wu2022) SDSS quasar catalog

what.value: Combined image and SED decomposition method with modified likelihood

evidence.quote: Following the method from (cite: Yu2025), we incorporate morphology constraint from image decomposition into SED fitting.

unstated_but_needed: Which ALMA project data and what flux values were used for J1126, J0220, J0116
How ALMA data were reduced and photometry measured
BayeSED3 priors, sampler settings and parameter ranges

method.value: Bayesian SED fitting with stellar, CLUMPY AGN and graybody cold dust components

evidence.quote: The SED analysis from UV to millimeter is performed using the Bayesian SED fitting code BayeSED3

assumptions.value: BC03 SSP, Chabrier IMF, Calzetti attenuation, exponentially declining SFH

evidence.quote: We assume the (cite: Chabrier2003) initial mass function (IMF), the (cite: Calzetti2000) dust attenuation law, and an exponentially declining star formation history (SFH).

method.value: Single-epoch virial estimator using obscuration-corrected continuum luminosity from CLUMPY model and catalog FWHM

evidence.quote: we use the CLUMPY model (cite: Nenkova2008a; Nenkova2008b) adopted in the SED fitting to derive the obscuration-corrected monochromatic continuum luminosity.
Bayesian SED fitting code BayeSED3

used_for.value: HST image decomposition into Sersic plus point source

evidence.quote: Using `GaLight` (cite: Ding2021), we simultaneously fit the host galaxy and the AGN as a Sersic profile and a point source.
reconstruct a median stack PSF using PSFr (Birrer et al. in prep)

results_numeric.quantity: Median Eddington ratio of 11 high-z Hot DOGs

evidence.quote: with the median value of 1.05 and the maximum value close to 3

results_numeric.quantity: Median log(M_BH/M_star) of eight Hot DOGs (16th, 50th, 84th percentiles)

evidence.quote: the 16th, 50th, and 84th percentiles are $-2.14$, $-1.83$, and $-1.31$, respectively

claims.hypothesis: Hot DOGs deviate from the local M_BH-M_star relation
claims.experiment: SED and HST decomposition for stellar mass; virial BH masses
claims.result: Median M_BH/M_star only slightly above local 1 sigma range, within 2 sigma
claims.finding: No significant difference from the local relation

evidence.quote: We find no significant differences in the $M_{\rm BH}/M_\star$ of these Hot DOGs compared to the local relation

claims.hypothesis: Hot DOGs accrete at high Eddington ratios
claims.experiment: L_AGN from AGN component over L_Edd
claims.finding: Super-Eddington accretion possibly linked to overdense environments

evidence.quote: We find high Eddington ratios $\lambda_{\rm Edd}$ in these Hot DOGs

limitations_admitted.value: J0834 fit is unreliable due to an anomalous UV bump and a dominant AGN

evidence.quote: Consequently, the resulting ratio, although retained in the figure, is noted to have low reliability.

referee_caveats_inferred: ALMA plays a minor role and its use is undescribed
Small sample with large BH mass and stellar mass uncertainties
Virial masses rely on model-corrected luminosity

data_public_as_stated.value: Data from public archives (ALMA, Herschel, MAST, SDSS)

evidence.quote: Three sources (J1126, J0220, and J0116) have ALMA data collected from ALMA Science Archive

missing_for_reproduction: ALMA project codes in text and the continuum flux extraction
reproducibility.estimated_data_volume_inferred: Small; photometry only, tens of GB at most if ALMA data are reprocessed
reproducibility.score_reason: Public data and named software, but ALMA handling and fit settings are unstated.
reproducibility.rediscovery_reason: ALMA role is minor and settings are incomplete.
